Shanghai Municipal Police.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No 109
Date 28 / 16
Central Police Station.
January 4th 1916.
REPORT ON Distribution of Anti-Monarchical Pamphlets
Made by D.S.Givens Forwarded by
Sir,
I beg to report that the attached pamphlet was handed
to a resident of Gordon Road District in a teashop in Louza
district on 2nd instant. It purports to be signed by one
Lieu Khoong( 劉公 ), who took a prominent part in the first
revolution at Wuchang, and is addressed to the Chinese people.
The subject matter of this pamphlet is substantially the same
as the manifesto issued by the Yunnan Military Government, and
published in last night's edition of the Shanghai Mercury.
Attached please find a cutting from the Shanghai Mercury
containing the manifesto above referred to.
5/6-
I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.

谨此报告，所附传单于本月2日在老闸区的一家茶馆内递交给戈登路区的一名居民。该传单署名为刘公（Lieu Khoong），此人曾在武昌首义中发挥重要作用，收件人为中国民众。
本传单的主旨与云南军政府发布的宣言基本相同，该宣言已刊登于昨晚出版的《字林西报》上。
随函附上《字林西报》剪报一份，其中载有上述宣言。

YUNNAN'S DECLARATION.

We have received the following:—
MANIFESTO FROM THE YUNNAN MILITARY
GOVERNMENT OF THE PUNITIVE ARMY
REPRESENTING REPUBLICAN CHINA
AGAINST HIGH TREASON TO
THE FRIENDLY POWERS,
GREETING.

It is the bounden duty of every nation
in this world to act in conformity with the
principles of fairness and civilisation in
order that the people may show their good
qualities and perform their part towards
the uplifting of mankind. Harmonious
co-operation between China and the
foreign countries as well as that between
governor and governed must be built
upon the solid foundation of sincerity
and fairness. During the last years
of the Tsing Dynasty the misrule of
the country was in direct contravention
of the modern principles of government;
and in consequence our citizens in-
augurated a new regime and established
the present republican form of government.
Yuan Shih-kai professed his attachment
to the new government with the selfish
object of advancing himself to the office
of President. Twice upon accepting the
office he swore before the people of China
and the foreign nations that he would be
faithful to the Republic and that he
would strictly observe the constitution.
Notwithstanding this he has during his
administration and on divers occasions set
the constitution at naught; and had not
his despotic rule endangered the very
existence of the state, our people would
have borne it with patience in order to
see the result of his administration.
But during the past four years he has
exercised his powers in the most arbitrary
manner, and has had recourse to vile
intrigues and most unscrupulous methods
with the result that public opinion has been
suppressed and good and peaceful citizens
put to death. Indeed, his abuse of power
has even gone to the extent of tampering
with the conscience of the entire people.
If we examine the results of his
administration, we find that he has
sucked out the blood of the people and
has rendered their lives miserable for
the purpose of gratifying his tyrannical
ambitions. Should this state of things
be suffered to continue for any length of
time, no trace of humanity will be left
in China. Moreover, his policy towards
the foreign powers has been one of deceit
and trickery, in consequence of which
our country has entirely lost her prestige
in the family of nations.

A great civil commotion has thus become
inevitable which will give cause for an-
xiety to the friendly powers. Instead of
repenting of his crimes Yuan Shih Kai
has now even dared to violate his oath
of office; he has surrounded himself with
partisans; he has deliberately misrepre-
sented the people's will and has made
himself emperor, overawing the people
on the one hand and imposing upon the
foreign nations on the other. He has
been advised in vain to follow the path
of sincerity and righteousness, and every
means of making him abide by the con-
stitution has been tried without result.
This Military Government cannot but
look with commiseration upon the de-
struction of human principles and the
end of our national existence, and has
therefore solemnly resolved to mobilize
all its forces to punish the traitor
who has rendered himself guilty of
violating his oath of office, of setting the
constitution at naught, of bringing disaster
to the people, and of usurping the powers
of government. All patriotic citizens,
whether Northerners or Southerners, and
all military and civil officials, whether
they belong to the Moderate or the
Radical Party, have agreed after mutual
consultation to proclaim the justice of our
cause.
Now that we have been forced to take
up arms to defend and preserve the Chung
Hua Republic to which all official recogni-
tion has been accorded by all the friendly
powers, we earnestly hope that they will
have pity on our plight, recognize our
cause, and appreciate the justice of our
acts. We do hereby publicly declare
that all treaties and agreements conclud-
ed with the friendly powers prior to the
date of the proclamation of our righteous
cause against high treason, to wit, the
fifth of December in the fourth year of
the Republic of China, shall continue to
have full force and effect, and that within
the jurisdiction of our Army we shall
assume responsibility for the protection
of foreign lives, commerce, and missions
as well as for the due performance of
all treaty obligations. All foreign rela-
tions shall henceforth be conducted
between the representatives of this
Military Government specially authorized
to act at behalf and the foreign ministers
and consuls.
This Military Government further
declares before Heaven and Earth that
from and after this date it will do every-
thing within its power to govern the
country in harmony with the principles
of civilization, so that our people may
enjoy the real blessings of republicanism;
and will also conduct our foreign policy
with frankness and sincerity, so that our
relations with the friendly powers may
become closer and more amicable. Heaven
witnesseth this our solemn declaration.
Yunnanfu, December, 1915.

云南的宣言。

我们收到如下内容：—
代表中华民国讨袁护国军
云南军政府
致友好各国
关于严惩叛国罪行的宣言，
敬启者。

当今世界，每个国家都有责任按照公平与文明的原则行事，以便人民展现其优良品质，并为提升人类福祉尽其本分。中国与外国之间以及统治者与被统治者之间的和谐合作，必须建立在真诚与公平的坚实基础之上。在清朝末年，国家的弊政直接违背了现代治理原则；因此，我国公民开启了新体制，建立了现行的共和政体。袁世凯声称拥护新政府，但其自私的目的是为了让自己登上总统之位。他在两次就职时，曾在中国人民和外国面前宣誓，表示将忠于共和国并严格遵守宪法。尽管如此，他在执政期间及多个场合公然无视宪法；若非其专制统治危及国家的生存，我国人民本会耐心忍受，以观察其施政结果。但在过去四年中，他以最专断的方式行使权力，诉诸卑鄙的阴谋和最肆无忌惮的手段，导致舆论受到压制，善良和平的公民遭到杀害。事实上，他滥用权力甚至到了操纵全体人民良知的地步。如果我们审视其施政结果，就会发现他为了满足其暴虐的野心，吸干了人民的血汗，使他们的生活陷入痛苦。如果这种状况持续任何一段时间，中国将不留任何人性的痕迹。此外，他对列强的政策充满了欺骗和诡计，导致我国在国际社会中完全丧失了威望。

因此，一场大规模的内乱已变得不可避免，这将引起友好各国的担忧。袁世凯非但没有悔过自新，现在甚至胆敢违背其就职誓言；他结党营私；故意歪曲民意，自立为皇帝，一方面威慑人民，另一方面欺瞒外国。人们劝他遵循真诚和正义之路，但徒劳无功；为使他就范遵守宪法而采取的一切手段均未奏效。本军政府目睹人道原则的毁灭和国家生存的终结，不禁深感同情，因此庄严决议动员全部力量，惩罚那名犯下违背就职誓言、无视宪法、给人民带来灾难以及篡夺政府权力罪行的叛徒。所有爱国公民，无论南北，以及所有文武官员，无论属于温和派还是激进派，经相互协商后，均同意宣告我方事业的正义性。
既然我们被迫拿起武器来保卫和维护中华民国——该国已获得所有友好各国的正式承认——我们恳切希望各国能怜悯我们的处境，认可我们的事业，并理解我们行动的正义性。我们特此公开声明，在我们宣布讨伐叛国罪行之日（即中华民国四年十二月五日）之前与友好各国缔结的所有条约和协定，将继续保持完全效力；在我军管辖范围内，我们将承担保护外国人生命、商业及传教活动以及适当履行所有条约义务的责任。此后，所有对外关系将由本军政府特别授权的代表与外国公使和领事进行交涉。
本军政府进一步对天地庄严宣告，自即日起，我们将竭尽所能，按照文明原则治理国家，使我国人民能够享受共和制的真正福祉；并将以坦率和真诚的态度开展外交政策，使我们与友好各国的关系变得更加紧密和友好。天地共鉴此庄严宣言。
云南府，1915年12月。
